arStrings.szText: "Are you...are you all right? The vision you saw, when is it going to happen?"
The ruin I saw will not come to pass in our lifetime. Nothing we do will stop it. But at least I know.
Calm acceptance. Strangely unemotional about the end of the world.
I am going to return to Vision’s End. To Laurel. I have had my last vision. I will be there for hers.
For the first time since I can remember, I can enjoy the summer’s breeze. (sighs)
Peaceful and content savoring a simple joy she hadn't allowed herself before
